name: Rivaroxaban
executiveSummary: Anti-Xa DOAC. Nonvalvular AF: **20 mg PO/day** with food (**15 mg** if CrCl 15–49). DVT/PE: **15 mg q12h × 21 days** → **20 mg/day**. Ortho prophylaxis: **10 mg/day**. Not for mechanical valves; adjust for renal function.
indications:
## Indications

- Stroke prevention in nonvalvular AF; DVT/PE treatment/prevention; hip/knee surgery prophylaxis.

## Precautions

- Bleeding; avoid if CrCl <15 (AF) per label; avoid in pregnancy.
- Interactions with strong CYP3A4/P-gp inhibitors/inducers.
- 15–20 mg doses: **with food** (absorption).
- Antidote: andexanet alfa (if available); PCC off-label.

> Not for rheumatic valvular AF / mechanical prosthesis.

adulto.dose: AF: **20 mg/day** with food (**15 mg/day** if CrCl 15–49). Acute DVT/PE: **15 mg q12h × 21 d** then **20 mg/day**. Extension: sometimes **10 mg/day**. Ortho prophylaxis: **10 mg/day**. ACS (label): **2.5 mg q12h** + aspirin ± clopidogrel — specialist.
adulto.notes: Missed BID 15 mg dose: take ASAP to complete 30 mg/day.

pediatrico.dose: Pediatric VTE: weight/age schemes on label — hematology only.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Bleeding, anemia, dizziness; rare: SJS, hepatotoxicity.
